content.name: Feather Token, Bird
entries: This tiny object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect.

entries.name: Bird
entries: You can use an action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a {@creature roc}, but it obeys your simple commands and can't attack. It can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles an hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day. with a one-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying), or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 hit points. You can dismiss the bird as an action.

content.name: Feather Token, Bird
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a {@creature Roc|SRD52}, but it can't attack. It obeys your simple commands and can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles per hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day, with a 1-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying) or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. You can dismiss the bird as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.
